info.name: SBOM
info.description:
Secret BOM (SBOM) – XDS Policy Validation

Purpose:
Verifies that D365 Extended Data Security (XDS) policies correctly filter items 18000-18499 from all protected data entities.

Test data:
  Parent item   : 85375  (BOM header – all components visible)
  Phantom item  : 89002  (phantom BOM – all lines are in the restricted range)
  Control items : 14244, 18963, 18959  (must remain visible)
  Restricted range: 18000-18499  (must NOT appear in any response – see restrictedRangeMin/Max)

Structure:
Each folder maps to one XDS-protected D365 table. Run a folder to validate that table's policy. Every request checks:
  1. HTTP 200 OK
  2. No restricted item IDs (18000-18499) appear in any item field
  3. At least one record is returned (proof that XDS has not '  blocked everything)

Variables required (set in environment):
  base_url    – e.g. https://your-d365.operations.dynamics.com
  access_token – OAuth 2.0 bearer token
  company_id  – legal entity (e.g. 500)

item.name: Access Control
item.description:
Access control audit for TSISBOM XDS policies.

These requests query SecurityUserRoles to identify users who have been manually excluded from the automatic TSISBOM XDS role assignments.

The TSISBOM XDS roles are assigned automatically to all users. A user whose assignment has been manually set to Disabled is exempted from the restriction and can see items 18000-18499 in full. This folder helps identify those exemptions.
